summary: The persistent timed OpenMP worker 0x2260 receives the requested count and per-thread row bounds. For each repetition it processes all assigned rows and every CSR nonzero in each row, computes the indexed product sum, and stores output; empty rows are explicitly zeroed. Source bounds are computed for the complete row domain.

source_evidence.claim: Row helper covers full CSR intervals; runtime dimensions/iterations determine nonzero count and timed call; setup and persistent OMP loop use per-thread row bounds.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked GOMP call at 0x1c45 targets outlined worker 0x2260. Worker loads assigned bounds and count, traverses row and nonzero loops with indexed multiply/add and result stores, handles empty rows, then increments the repetition counter at 0x234e, compares it to the requested count at 0x2350 and branches from 0x2353 to 0x22f0 for another complete pass.
